title: 3rd Stopping Place 4th Truth The Universal Manifestation Of Compassionateness And Providerhood

questions.question: What is the main topic of this passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s caring mercy and giving food and needs to living things.

questions.question: Where does the passage say living things get what they need?
questions.answer: On land, in the earth, in the air, and in the sea.

questions.question: Which living beings are given special attention in the passage?
questions.answer: Those with life and spirit, especially the weak, helpless, and young.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about who really gives provision?
questions.answer: Allah is the real Provider.

questions.question: What does the verse about every creature on earth teach?
questions.answer: Every creature depends on Allah for its food and needs.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah knows about creatures?
questions.answer: He knows where they stay and where they are kept.

questions.question: Which creatures are mentioned as unable to get food by themselves?
questions.answer: Weak and powerless creatures.

questions.question: What example is given to show that even tiny creatures are provided for?
questions.answer: Small creatures in the deep sea and their babies are fed.

questions.question: Who especially needs this reminder about provision?
questions.answer: People who think causes are the real reason things are given.

questions.question: What mistake do those people make?
questions.answer: They do not see that Allah gives through those causes.

questions.question: Is the proof in this passage from only one sign or from many signs?
questions.answer: From many signs, including Qur’an verses and signs in creation.

questions.question: What do all these signs show together?
questions.answer: They show one glorious Provider cares for all living things.

questions.question: Why is giving food in an orderly and timely way amazing?
questions.answer: Because so many different creatures get what they need without mix-up or delay.

questions.question: What truth is named in this passage?
questions.answer: The truth of mercy and giving provision.

questions.question: What kinds of needs are given to living things?
questions.answer: Physical needs and other kinds of needs too.

questions.question: What surprising places are named as sources for provision?
questions.answer: Dry soil, hard wood, and milk that comes from inside the body.

questions.question: How is this giving described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is careful, on time, orderly, and without missing anyone.

questions.question: Whose hand is said to do this, even though it is not seen?
questions.answer: Allah’s power gives it, though people do not see Him.

questions.question: What does the first Qur’an verse in the passage say about Allah?
questions.answer: He is the Provider and very strong.

questions.question: What does the second Qur’an verse promise for creatures?
questions.answer: Their provision is guaranteed by Allah.

questions.question: Does the passage say creatures depend fully on themselves or on Allah?
questions.answer: They depend on Allah.

questions.question: What does the third Qur’an verse say about animals that do not store food?
questions.answer: Allah still provides for them and for people too.

questions.question: How may provision come to weak creatures, according to the passage?
questions.answer: In ways they do not expect, from the unseen.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention ocean creatures and their young?
questions.answer: To show Allah feeds even hidden and tiny creatures.

questions.question: What two kinds of proof are used in the passage?
questions.answer: Verses from the Qur’an and signs in the world.

questions.question: What big idea do these proofs support?
questions.answer: One merciful Provider takes care of every living being.

questions.question: What is being given to living creatures in this passage?
questions.answer: Their needed provision.

questions.question: Which group is cared for in a very special way?
questions.answer: The weak, helpless, and young.

questions.question: What does “material and immaterial” mean here in a simple way?
questions.answer: Needs for the body and other needs too.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the timing of provision?
questions.answer: It comes at the right time.

questions.question: What does the passage say about mistakes in this giving?
questions.answer: There are no omissions or mix-ups.

questions.question: According to the passage, who alone has the job of giving provision?
questions.answer: Allah alone.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah knows about each creature besides giving food?
questions.answer: He knows its place and where it is kept.

questions.question: What kind of creatures are said to be unable to secure their own food?
questions.answer: Helpless and weak creatures.

questions.question: What lesson is taught by saying provision can come from the unseen or from where we do not expect?
questions.answer: Allah can provide in ways beyond what people plan.

questions.question: Which wrong belief is the passage warning against?
questions.answer: Thinking causes themselves are the real providers.

questions.question: If someone sees causes as the source, what truth are they missing?
questions.answer: Allah gives provision behind those causes.

questions.question: How do the Qur’an and the world agree in this passage?
questions.answer: Both show that one glorious Provider nurtures all living things.

questions.question: What two qualities of Allah are highlighted in this passage’s title?
questions.answer: Compassion and giving provision.

questions.question: To how much of the world does this care reach?
questions.answer: It reaches all over the world.

questions.question: What areas are listed to show how wide this care is?
questions.answer: The land, inside the earth, the air, and the ocean.

questions.question: Which creatures are especially mentioned after all living things?
questions.answer: Those with spirit, especially the weak and the little ones.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the way provision is given?
questions.answer: It is given with care, order, and no confusion.

questions.question: Why is getting food from dry ground and hard wood a sign of Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because life-giving food comes from things that seem unable to make it.

questions.question: What does the passage use to show very delicate nourishment?
questions.answer: Milk for the young.

questions.question: What does the verse about Allah being the Provider teach us?
questions.answer: Allah has the strength and power to provide.

questions.question: What promise is found in the verse about every moving creature?
questions.answer: Allah takes care of its sustenance.

questions.question: Who receives provision even if they cannot gather it themselves?
questions.answer: Weak creatures and animals.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention people who worship causes?
questions.answer: Because they wrongly give credit to causes instead of Allah.

questions.question: What is really working behind the veil of causes?
questions.answer: Allah’s giving and care.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the passage make from many verses and signs?
questions.answer: One glorious and merciful Provider raises and feeds all living beings.

questions.question: What is one main message of this passage for our hearts?
questions.answer: Allah lovingly cares for all living things.

questions.question: Does the passage speak about only people, or about all animate beings?
questions.answer: It speaks about all animate beings.

questions.question: Which creatures are especially pointed out as needing care?
questions.answer: The weak, powerless, and young.

questions.question: What does the passage say is given besides food for the body?
questions.answer: Other needed gifts too.

questions.question: How can we tell from the passage that provision is not random?
questions.answer: It comes in order, at the right time, and without neglect.

questions.question: What hidden source is mentioned for provision?
questions.answer: The unseen.

questions.question: What truth do the Qur’an verses repeat in different ways?
questions.answer: Allah alone provides sustenance.

questions.question: What does the verse about creatures on earth say they rely on?
questions.answer: Allah’s provision.

questions.question: What extra knowledge of Allah is mentioned with that verse?
questions.answer: He knows their places and where they are stored.

questions.question: What does the verse about animals that do not carry food teach?
questions.answer: Allah feeds them even when they do not gather food themselves.

questions.question: What example helps us imagine Allah’s care for very hidden creatures?
questions.answer: He provides even for creatures on the ocean floor and their young.

questions.question: What kind of people are being corrected by this message?
questions.answer: People who trust causes instead of Allah.

questions.question: What do the signs of the universe and the Qur’an both witness to?
questions.answer: The mercy of one Provider caring for every living thing.

questions.question: What is the name of the truth in this passage?
questions.answer: The truth of compassion and provision.

questions.question: What does “provision” mean in this passage?
questions.answer: The food and other needs living things receive.

questions.question: How far does Allah’s providing reach, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Everywhere in the world.

questions.question: What four places are named to show this wide care?
questions.answer: The land, under the ground, the air, and the sea.

questions.question: Which living beings are given as special examples of Allah’s mercy?
questions.answer: The helpless, weak, and young.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the order of Allah’s giving?
questions.answer: It is neat, timely, and without confusion.

questions.question: What do the Qur’an verses in the passage help prove?
questions.answer: That Allah alone is the true Provider.

questions.question: What does the passage say about every creature’s sustenance?
questions.answer: It is under Allah’s care.

questions.question: What else besides sustenance does Allah know about creatures in the passage?
questions.answer: Their place of staying and their place of storage.

questions.question: Why is it important that weak creatures are mentioned?
questions.answer: It shows Allah provides even when they cannot help themselves.

questions.question: What unusual example shows Allah’s care reaches hidden places?
questions.answer: He feeds creatures at the bottom of the sea and their babies.

questions.question: What false idea is being warned against in this passage?
questions.answer: Thinking that causes themselves give provision.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do many Qur’an verses and many signs in creation show together?
questions.answer: One glorious Provider, with mercy, nurtures all living beings.
